purpose: C.9 Example 11 (quarterly-gated lounge quota): two qualifying quarters and two that fall short, exercising per-quarter independence and threshold-gated countable-benefit entitlement. No caps, no exclusions, no waiver threshold on this card.

assumptions.note: Dining ticket 600 is an exact multiple of the base rule's 150-unit -- zero floor loss, no rounding_estimated flag expected. syn_lounge has no waiver threshold, so the annual fee is always charged in full. Need=6 is below the 8 visits earned (2 qualifying quarters x 4), so Need is the binding constraint on benefit value.

_hand_computation: Seasonality weights (Jan..Dec) applied to Rs 3,00,000 annual dining spend: Jan 45,000, Feb 30,000, Mar 30,000, Apr 15,000, May 15,000, Jun 15,000, Jul 45,000, Aug 30,000, Sep 30,000, Oct 15,000, Nov 15,000, Dec 15,000.
Q3 = same as Q1 = 1,05,000 -> qualifies, grants 4 more visits.
Q4 = same as Q2 = 45,000 -> does not qualify.
Total entitlement = 2 qualifying quarters x 4 = 8 lounge visits/year.
GR (base rule 2pts/Rs150, ticket 600, zero floor loss, ea=2/150=1/75 exactly): Rs45,000 month -> 600pts; Rs30,000 month -> 400pts; Rs15,000 month -> 200pts.
Points valuation at declared primary route 'stmt': ratio 0.25, default friction 1.0 -> 0.25/pt. GR = 4,000 x 0.25 = 1,000.
Benefit value: min(Need 6, Entitlement 8) x Rs800/visit = 6 x 800 = 4,800.
No waiver threshold -- fee always charged in full. Steady fee = 5,000 x 1.18 = 5,900. Year-1 fee = (5,000+5,000) x 1.18 = 11,800.
NACV steady-state = 1,000 (GR) + 0 (no milestone grants on this card) + 4,800 (benefit) - 5,900 (fee) = -100.
